name: @mandusec/inspect-mcp
description: Mandu M4 (cooperative U-LLM path): an MCP stdio server exposing the inspect_symbol tool. Resolves a $MDU:* symbol to its raw value via the arbiter, processes it in a QUARANTINED model call (U-LLM) with NO T-LLM context, then RE-SYMBOLIZES the result via the arbiter so untrusted text never re-enters T-LLM. Fail-closed. Zero runtime deps (hand-rolled stdio JSON-RPC). Lifted logic from adfi-openclaw/plugin/adfi/adfi-inspect-symbol.ts (see provenance headers).
